evidence.why: Config change on 2026-10-20 updated the schedule cron expression.
Previous schedule ran daily at 02:00 UTC.
New schedule runs only in February (month 2) at 02:00 on day 0, preventing the job from running daily in October.

args.root_cause: A config change on 2026-10-20 modified the pipeline schedule from daily (0 2 * * *) to February-only (0 2 * 2 *), causing the order_sync job to stop running outside of February and violating the freshness SLA.
args.suggested_fix: Revert the schedule in pipeline.yaml back to daily (0 2 * * *).
